title: Default Python regression tests depend on an undeclared host uv binary
claim: The three materialization tests in crates/opi-eval/scripts/test_native_smoke_output_control.py error on any host without /usr/bin/uv: the mocked subprocess for `command -v uv` returns the hardcoded path /usr/bin/uv while the materialize-configs stage embedded in native-smoke.sh performs a real shutil.copy2 of the resolved binary, so the default registered verification command python -m unittest discover -s crates/opi-eval/scripts -p 'test_*.py' fails on such hosts (observed: 3 errors of 251 on this WSL Ubuntu without uv installed) despite the test docstring claiming only external commands are replaced.

evidence.detail: command() returns subprocess.CompletedProcess(argv, 0, "/usr/bin/uv\n", "") for ["sh","-c","command -v uv"] without creating that file
materialize-configs resolves uv via `command -v uv` and does shutil.copy2(uv, cache/"tools"/"uv") on the real host path

evidence.location: observed unittest run in the audit_head export (WSL Ubuntu, no uv on PATH)
evidence.detail: ERROR test_failed_or_incomplete_probe_never_freezes_material (failure='probe' and 'missing') and ERROR test_proof_precedes_material_validation_and_config_freeze, all FileNotFoundError/FileExistsError from /usr/bin/uv; 247 pass, 1 docker-gated skip

criterion_source: docs/snapshots/phase19/opi-impl-state.json#task-19.10 definition_of_done (P19-AC-011 deterministic default tests; run every touched Python test file)
reproduction: python3 -m unittest discover -s crates/opi-eval/scripts -p 'test_*.py'  # on a host without /usr/bin/uv: 3 errors in test_native_smoke_output_control.MaterializeOutputControlTest

title: Acceptance audit doc references only the superseded 2026-09-15 root; the currently accepted re-collection is discoverable solely via the evidence-root registry
claim: docs/audits/phase19-local-native-acceptance.md and .zh.md record the 2026-09-15 evidence root as the formal six-trial handoff and state the current verifier rejects it, but neither cross-references the 2026-09-29 re-collected root that the current verifier accepts (registered only in docs/eval/evidence-roots.jsonl, whose owning report was removed from the checkout per the docs/eval/README.md conclusion-pair contract); a reader of the audit documents alone cannot locate the currently consumable acceptance evidence without consulting the registry or Git history.

evidence.detail: records the 2026-09-15 root and its current-verifier rejection as historical; links only docs/eval/evidence-roots.jsonl

kind=acceptance path=.../phase19-acceptance-20260929/evidence-root, material/6, status 'accepted by the current verifier (verify-local-acceptance exit 0, accepted:true; artifact audit ok)', report path removed from checkout

evidence.location: independent re-verification performed by this audit
evidence.detail: verify-local-acceptance.py at audit_head accepted the registered re-collected root (exit 0) and scripts/opi-artifact-audit.py passed, confirming the registry claim

reproduction: grep -n '2026-09-29' docs/audits/phase19-local-native-acceptance.md docs/audits/phase19-local-native-acceptance.zh.md  # no match; the accepted re-collection appears only in docs/eval/evidence-roots.jsonl
